content.text: I’ve pinned the review to the actual committed blobs now. The committed `HEAD` version does not include the uncommitted repo-local-config changes in your worktree, so I’m reviewing the smaller net change from `48e32b2...HEAD` only.

1. Severity: Medium. Relevance: the change still misses a common 1Password configuration path. Lens: logic/config resolution. File:line: [cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner.go](/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.worktrees/fix/1password-commit-signing/cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner.go:64). Issue: `loadObjectSignerConfig` only reads `SystemScope` and `GlobalScope`, so repo-local `gpg.ssh.program` is still invisible to the skip logic. Why: users commonly scope signing config per-repo; in that case `RegisterObjectSigner` will still try native SSH signing instead of silently skipping, which is the failure mode this diff is trying to avoid. Evidence: the new helper merges only `loadScopedConfig(..., config.SystemScope)` and `loadScopedConfig(..., config.GlobalScope)` at lines 65-68; upstream `plugin.ConfigSource` explicitly says local scope is not provided by the loader and must come from repository storage (`x/plugin/plugin_config.go`); upstream `Repository.ConfigScoped` merges `system, global, local` (`repository.go:690-724`). The new tests never set repo-local config. Suggested fix: include repository-local config in the effective signer config/detection path and add a regression test with local `gpg.ssh.program = op-ssh-sign`.

2. Severity: Low. Relevance: the new tests do not fully protect the precedence-sensitive behavior this refactor introduced. Lens: missing tests. File:line: [cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner_test.go](/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.worktrees/fix/1password-commit-signing/cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner_test.go:88), [cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner_test.go](/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.worktrees/fix/1password-commit-signing/cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner_test.go:164). Issue: the suite never covers “lower-precedence custom program overridden by higher-precedence `ssh-keygen`”. Why: that is the case `effectiveSSHSignProgram` exists to handle; without it, a regression back to “any custom program in any scope disables signing” would still pass these tests. Evidence: production now uses `effectiveSSHSignProgram` at [objectsigner.go:67](/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.worktrees/fix/1password-commit-signing/cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner.go:67) and [objectsigner.go:106](/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.worktrees/fix/1password-commit-signing/cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner.go:106), but `TestCustomSSHSignProgramDetection_UsesScopedRawBeforeMerge` checks `custom(sys) || custom(global)` at lines 151-159, and the only precedence test exercises custom-over-custom, not `ssh-keygen`-over-custom. Suggested fix: add a case with system `op-ssh-sign` plus global `ssh-keygen`, and assert both `effectiveSSHSignProgram()` and the registration path keep native signing enabled.
